name: Hexapod Fresh
description: Fresh 25 kg-servo hexapod using new printable CAD while preserving validation, MuJoCo, and BuildViz workflows.

instances.name: Open Spider Chassis
instances.role: Fresh lower frame: central rounded spine plus six local yaw-pod pads, with open bays instead of a solid hex plate.

envelope.label: Generated part envelope
envelope.purpose: Regression contract for the generated STL size.
envelope.llm_context: Changing pod reach or centre-spine size changes this envelope and may affect bed fit and novelty.

length_x.label: X envelope
length_x.llm_hint: Keep under printer and avoid becoming reference-like.

thickness_z.label: Plate thickness
thickness_z.llm_hint: Changing this affects bolt length and mass.

centre_standoff_pattern.label: Centre standoff pattern
centre_standoff_pattern.purpose: Four M3 holes tie the top saddle and electronics stack to the lower chassis.

hole_diameter.label: M3 clearance diameter
hole_diameter.llm_hint: Do not shrink below M3 clearance.

leg0_pod_bolt_outboard_n.label: Leg 0 pod bolt sample
leg0_pod_bolt_outboard_n.purpose: Representative bolt in the repeated yaw-pod mounting pattern.
leg0_pod_bolt_outboard_n.llm_context: The six legs repeat this local pattern around the chassis.

hole_diameter.label: Pod M3 clearance diameter
hole_diameter.description: Clearance through chassis pad for yaw-pod mounting.
hole_diameter.llm_hint: Moving this requires moving yaw_pod chassis holes.

instances.name: Top Electronics Saddle
instances.role: Compact rounded upper deck for electronics and chassis standoffs.

envelope.label: Generated part envelope
envelope.purpose: Regression contract for top saddle dimensions.
envelope.llm_context: The saddle must remain inside leg sweep and align with centre standoffs.

length_x.label: X envelope
length_x.llm_hint: Increasing may collide with leg sweep.

width_y.label: Y envelope
width_y.llm_hint: Must fit electronics but stay compact.

centre_standoff_pattern.label: Centre standoff pattern
centre_standoff_pattern.purpose: Four M3 holes align with the lower chassis standoff pattern.
centre_standoff_pattern.llm_context: Must stay aligned to spider_chassis centre_standoff_pattern.

hole_diameter.label: M3 clearance diameter
hole_diameter.llm_hint: Keep consistent with lower chassis.

instances.name: Canted Yaw Servo Pod L0
instances.role: Separate canted pod that bolts to one chassis pad and holds a 25 kg yaw servo.

envelope.label: Generated part envelope
envelope.llm_context: Changing servo wall thickness or pod base affects this size.

height_z.label: Pod height
height_z.llm_hint: Must clear horn sweep and servo body.

chassis_bolt_pattern.label: Pod-to-chassis bolt pattern
chassis_bolt_pattern.purpose: Four M3 bolts fasten the pod to a local chassis pad.
chassis_bolt_pattern.llm_context: Keep matched to spider_chassis leg pad holes.

hole_diameter.label: M3 clearance diameter
hole_diameter.llm_hint: Do not shrink below M3 clearance.

yaw_servo_pocket.label: Yaw servo body pocket
yaw_servo_pocket.purpose: Void for the purchased 25 kg hobby servo body.
yaw_servo_pocket.llm_context: Changing this must preserve servo insertion and horn axis.

pocket_width_x.label: Servo tab span clearance
pocket_width_x.llm_hint: Must remain larger than physical servo tabs.

instances.name: Coxa Blade L0
instances.role: Short yaw-to-hip blade with integrated hip servo pocket.

envelope.label: Generated part envelope
envelope.llm_context: This is intentionally a blade, not the reference coxa bracket/link layout.

yaw_horn_pattern.label: Yaw horn bolt pattern
yaw_horn_pattern.purpose: M2 holes attach the blade to the purchased servo horn.
yaw_horn_pattern.llm_context: Must match the 20.8 mm horn PCD.

hole_diameter.label: M2 horn clearance
hole_diameter.llm_hint: Do not change without changing horn fasteners.

pcd_radius.label: Horn PCD radius
pcd_radius.llm_hint: Must stay aligned with servo horn.

instances.name: Femur Blade L0
instances.role: Tapered hip-to-knee blade with integrated knee servo block.

envelope.label: Generated part envelope
envelope.llm_context: Affects stride and knee servo placement.

hip_horn_pattern.label: Hip horn bolt pattern
hip_horn_pattern.purpose: M2 holes attach femur blade to hip servo horn.

hole_diameter.label: M2 horn clearance
hole_diameter.llm_hint: Keep aligned with horn hardware.

instances.name: Tibia Blade L0
instances.role: Long blade shin with passive foot clevis.

envelope.label: Generated part envelope
envelope.llm_context: Affects foot radius, gait reach, and novelty.

length_x.label: X envelope
length_x.llm_hint: Changing affects foot circle and MuJoCo model.

knee_horn_pattern.label: Knee horn bolt pattern
knee_horn_pattern.purpose: M2 holes attach tibia blade to knee servo horn.

hole_diameter.label: M2 horn clearance
hole_diameter.llm_hint: Keep aligned with horn hardware.

ankle_clevis.label: Passive ankle clevis
ankle_clevis.purpose: Captures the oval foot tongue on an M3 hinge pin.
ankle_clevis.llm_context: Changing this must preserve foot insertion and pin access.

pin_diameter.label: M3 hinge clearance
pin_diameter.llm_hint: Keep compatible with oval_foot hinge pin.

instances.name: Oval Foot L0
instances.role: Oval ground pad with vertical tongue and passive hinge pin.

envelope.label: Generated part envelope
envelope.llm_context: Foot shape intentionally differs from the reference round pad.

length_x.label: Oval foot length
length_x.llm_hint: Changing affects ground contact and novelty.

height_z.label: Foot height
height_z.description: Total foot and hinge tongue height.
height_z.llm_hint: Must align with tibia clevis pin.

hinge_pin.label: Foot hinge pin
hinge_pin.purpose: Passive pitch hinge captured by tibia clevis.
hinge_pin.llm_context: Must remain coaxial with tibia_blade ankle_clevis.
